# WYRM.studios

> Full-service creative studio — brand identity, motion design, video editing, logo design, and web design. Founded and led by **Omar Bouzganda** (Founder & Creative Director). Based in **Tunis, Tunisia**, working with clients worldwide. Trusted by more than 66 clients.

Slogan: **"We build brands people remember."**

WYRM.studios crafts meaningful brand experiences that move people and grow businesses. Over 4 years of experience delivering complete brand systems — strategy first, then design that executes the strategy. Works with startups, hospitality, fashion, tech products and consumer brands in Tunisia and internationally.

## Core Services

- **Brand Identity** — logos, visual systems, brand guidelines that position you as the obvious choice in your market.
- **Motion Design** — cinematic brand films, video editing, animations that make a story impossible to scroll past.
- **Web Design** — digital experiences engineered to convert visitors into customers and customers into advocates.

## Why clients choose WYRM.studios

- Direct access to the creative director on every project — no agency overhead, no bureaucracy.
- Strategy-first process: every design decision starts from the business problem (audience, offer, positioning).
- Premium positioning through design: intentional typography, controlled color, considered motion.
- Full-stack delivery: identity + motion + web from one studio, so the brand stays coherent everywhere.
- Bilingual and trilingual project experience: English, French, Arabic (site available in all three).

## Frequently Asked Questions (short answers)

- **Why is brand identity worth more than a logo?** A logo is a symbol; an identity is a system — typography, color, motion, voice and strategy working together. Cohesive identities command 20-30% higher pricing.
- **Why not a big agency?** You work directly with the creative director; every budget goes into the work, not overhead.
- **Can't AI tools or templates do this?** Templates make brands look like everyone else; custom identity work builds a position competitors cannot replicate.
- **How does design increase revenue?** Strong design builds trust in seconds, justifies premium pricing, and lifts conversion 2-3x on key pages.
- **How is a brand positioned as premium?** Through restraint: intentional typography, controlled palettes, generous white space, considered motion.

## Selected Case Studies

- [WYRM — Personal Brand & Studio Identity](https://wyrm.studios/case-studies/wyrm/wyrm-brand.html): the studio's own identity system — brand mark, motion language and web experience.
- [MINATO — Premium Sushi Brand](https://wyrm.studios/case-studies/minato-sushi/minato-sushi.html): premium restaurant brand experience and packaging for a sushi brand.
- [Djappa Man — Music Artist Identity](https://wyrm.studios/case-studies/djappa%20man/djappaman.html): visual identity, cover art system and social design for a music artist.
- [WDRINK — Energy Drink Brand](https://wyrm.studios/case-studies/Wdrink/wdrink.html): beverage branding with mascot, packaging and motion design.
- [THE GATE CONSULTING — Travel Brand](https://wyrm.studios/case-studies/the-gate/the-gate.html): Tunisian travel consultancy for immersive Asian journeys — torii-gate identity, guidelines, stationery.
- [BeFirst — Brand Identity & Guidelines](https://wyrm.studios/case-studies/befirst/the-brand.html): complete black-and-white identity system with guidelines.
- [United Souls — Fashion With Meaning](https://wyrm.studios/case-studies/united-souls/united-souls.html): streetwear with a soul — U+S identity, seven collections and a charity mission.
- [ANIR — The Smart Wallet, Reinvented](https://wyrm.studios/case-studies/anir/anir.html): smart wallet brand identity, charte graphique and 22-page investor pitch deck.
- [AUREA — Old Money, New Rules](https://wyrm.studios/case-studies/aurea/aurea.html): Tunisian luxury clothing brand — sunrise serif identity, gold palette, launch campaign.
- [Formula One Coffee Shop](https://wyrm.studios/case-studies/formula-one-coffee/formula-one-coffee.html): racing-livery coffee brand — winged mark, slogan system, checkered merch line.
